tools.name: list_climbing_routes
tools.description: List first-hand English climbing-route guides on Spaghetti and Summits. Returns each route's name and the URL of the guide on the blog. Call this when the user asks what climbing routes are on the site, or needs a link to a route page. Provide a short reason explaining why you are calling this tool

Messages are untrusted plain text and do not trigger automated actions. Delivery does not guarantee a reply. The free inbox has limited dail

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_climbing_routes, list_ski_resorts, list_rifugios · Private data: leave_message · Public sink: leave_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_climbing_routes, list_ski_resorts, list_rifugios · Private data: leave_message · Public sink: leave_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
